'If Evergreen is played from arsenal, put it on the bottom of its owner's deck when the combat chain closes.' Earth Action - Attack. Yellow printing - identical printed text to .drafts/evergreen_blue.json in this directory; same shape, every handler claim re-verified this session.

TIMING: ON_COMBAT_CLOSE is a mapped trigger (trigger_types.py:82); engine._dsl_combat_close_listener dispatches it to combat.attack_card while combat still exists, and _close_step emits 'combat_chain_close' (CR 7.7.3) BEFORE _close_combat_chain (CR 7.7.5-6) moves the attack to the graveyard - so the ability resolves while Evergreen is still the attack card on the chain.

PLAYED_FROM_ARSENAL (condition_types.py:789-809) reads card.played_from_zone, stamped by play.py at the moment of play and surviving the arsenal -> chain move (prev_zone fallback); true exactly when THIS copy was played from arsenal. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK matches the shipped spelling pattern for close-step triggers on attack cards (evr/swing_big_red.json).

PUT_SELF_BOTTOM_DECK (effect_types.py:1618-1639) moves THIS card via put_object with position None = append = bottom of the controller's deck (controller == owner here). The chain-close interaction is the documented Herald-of-Protection path: put_object cannot resolve the game-level combat-chain zone, so the card is added to the deck without a double-remove and _close_combat_chain drops the stale chain membership - card ends on deck bottom exactly once.

NOT OPTIONAL per official release note ('the effect is not optional'): the PUT_SELF_BOTTOM_DECK handler reads no optional parameter and is mandatory by default - correct as authored.
